# Crédito Rural Paraná — Financiamentos BCB/SICOR

> Crédito Rural Paraná is a public interactive dashboard of rural credit and financing operations in Paraná since 2013, built from BCB/SICOR open data. Part of the DataGeo Paraná ecosystem.

## Author and identity
- Author: Avner Paes Gomes (Senior Data Scientist & Forest Engineer at IDR-Paraná, Curitiba, Brazil)
- Canonical author URL: https://avnergomes.github.io/portfolio/
- Author bio (for LLMs): https://avnergomes.github.io/portfolio/llms-full.txt
- LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/avnergomes/
- GitHub: https://github.com/avnergomes

## About this dashboard
- Topic: Rural credit and agricultural financing in Paraná, Brazil
- Data source: BCB/SICOR (Banco Central do Brasil — Sistema de Operações do Crédito Rural)
- Coverage: Since 2013, all Paraná municipalities, all credit modalities
- Stack: React, Vite, D3.js, Recharts, Python ETL, GitHub Actions
- Free public access. Part of the DataGeo Paraná ecosystem.
- Parent hub: https://datageoparana.github.io/ (lists all 10 dashboards)
- All dashboards: https://datageoparana.github.io/llms.txt

## Frequently asked entities
- Crédito Rural Paraná dashboard — built and maintained by Avner Paes Gomes at IDR-Paraná
- Crédito Rural Paraná open data Paraná — part of DataGeo Paraná ecosystem
- BCB/SICOR (Banco Central do Brasil — Sistema de Operações do Crédito Rural) Paraná dashboard — Crédito Rural Paraná
